mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month decline in the federal funds rate compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of months where FEDFUNDS declined month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 7.0% signals a tightening labor market that boosts corporate profits and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE falls below 7.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals robust consumer demand, which increases corporate revenue visibility and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of months where both HOUST and RSAFS show positive month-over-month growth.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 2.5% year-over-year), rising inflation erodes real corporate profits and forces the Fed to tighten, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of months where CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) signals strong economic activity, which supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of months where INDPRO shows positive month-over-month growth.

mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month increase in non-farm payrolls above 0.5% signals strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of months where PAYEMS growth exceeds 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in real GDP (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) signals a broad-based economic expansion that increases business investment and consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of quarters where both GDPC1 and HOUST show positive year-over-year growth.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening regime (FEDFUNDS > 0.5%), rising interest rates increase the cost of capital and reduce equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of months where FEDFUNDS exceeds 0.5%.
